assignments.name: prompt
assignments.value: =Roll production back from the failed {{ $json.body.version }} deploy — there is no single ArgoCD Application per environment (each service has its own, `<ARGOCD_PROJECT>-<service>-production`), and 'rollback' here means restoring the previous known-good image tag, not re-syncing current (broken) state. For every file under env/production/*/values.yaml: run `git log -2 --format=%H -- <file>` to get its previous commit (before the {{ $json.body.version }} deploy that just failed), then `git show <previous-commit>:<file>` to read that prior version's content, and overwrite the current file with it. Commit all reverted files in one commit ('rollback: revert production to pre-{{ $json.body.version }} state') and push to main — ArgoCD's automated syncPolicy on each production Application picks up the reverted tag from there. Then wait for each service's production Deployment rollout to complete (kubectl --context $PRODUCTION_CLUSTER_CONTEXT rollout status deployment/<service> -n hr-portal --timeout=120s). If any env/production/*/values.yaml has no prior commit (first-ever deploy, nothing to roll back to), flag that service explicitly rather than silently skipping it. Report which services were reverted and to which tags.

parameters.name: message
parameters.value: ✅ Rollback complete — monitoring production, incident ticket opened
